d: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi is currently visiting Indonesia where he was given a grand welcome by President Prabowo Subianto. As part of the visit, Indonesia has signed deals to purchase the BrahMos supersonic cruise missile and the Astra BVR air-to-air missile. According to the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), Jakarta will receive two batteries of the BrahMos and will work with India on the Astra missile.
